x-wonton-title.zh: 我已阅读并同意 Minecraft EULA
x-wonton-title.en: I have read and accept the Minecraft EULA

x-wonton-description.zh: 服务端程序是 Mojang 的专有软件，必须先同意最终用户许可协议才能下载和运行：https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA
x-wonton-description.en: The server program is Mojang proprietary software; it can only be downloaded and run after accepting the EULA: https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA

x-wonton-description.zh: 原版是官方原汁原味；Paper 性能更好、插件更多，玩法上兼容原版
x-wonton-description.en: Vanilla is the official unmodified server; Paper performs better and supports plugins while staying compatible

x-wonton-description.zh: LATEST 跟随最新正式版；填具体版本号（如 1.21.4）可以钉住，大家的客户端要对得上
x-wonton-description.en: LATEST follows the newest release; pin a specific version (e.g. 1.21.4) so everyone's client matches

x-wonton-description.zh: 显示在客户端服务器列表里的一行字
x-wonton-description.en: The line shown under the server name in the client's server list

x-wonton-description.zh: 服务端 Java 堆的大小；人多、世界大就调大，别超过这台机器分给插件的内存上限
x-wonton-description.en: Java heap size for the server; raise it for more players or a bigger world, but stay under the memory the host grants this plugin

x-wonton-description.zh: 打开后只有名单上的玩家进得来
x-wonton-description.en: Only players on the list can join when enabled

x-wonton-description.zh: Minecraft 玩家名，用英文逗号分隔，如 Alex,Steve
x-wonton-description.en: Minecraft player names separated by commas, e.g. Alex,Steve
